// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// The permitted shape. An explicit projection, because a bare read would return
// the payload columns; and the uptake figure taken as a COUNT of the relation
// rather than a read of it, which is the one place a child-reaching relation
// name may appear. This answers "which activities are teachers actually taking"
// without opening a single template.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function sharedLibraryUptake() {
  return db.sharedActivity.findMany({
    select: {
      id: true,
      slug: true,
      title: true,
      published: true,
      sortOrder: true,
      _count: { select: { copies: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" },
  });
}
